result.title: SoftPAT3D: Physics-Augmented Text-to-3D Scene Generation with Deformables
result.summary: We present SoftPAT3D, a physics-augmented framework for text-to-3D scene generation in which deformable objects, such as cloth, stuffed toys and ropes, are generated as physically valid, simulation-ready bodies and placed in intersection-free contact with the furniture that supports them, with one another and with themselves. Existing physics-augmented pipelines simulate rigid bodies only and cannot accommodate a generated deformable object, which text-to-3D generation returns as a geometrically invalid mesh, sometimes self-intersecting, that has no rest shape, no material model and no admissible initial state. These are the inputs a deformable simulation requires, and we construct each from information already in the pipeline. The rest shape comes from how the object is manufactured rather than from the generated physically inconsistent deformed configuration, and a material library assigns each deformable object its initial elastic parameters, which can then be optimized. The occluded support is regenerated and converted into a watertight collision mesh, each object is released from an optimizable placement above the supporting part that the prompt specifies, and the complete scene is driven to static equilibrium under one unified contact model, with completion verified by geometric checks and a vision-language model. When a scene fails the prompt, a grid search over placements corrects it, and the adjoint of a differentiable simulation of the same contact energy reaches the targets the grid does not, places several bodies jointly and recovers and optimizes material parameters. Multi-body scenes equilibrate in a single simulation, and the pipeline also runs from the text prompt alone. On all sixty-five prompts, SoftPAT3D produces no undesired interpenetration of any kind, whereas every other system does, and its scenes directly support scene editing and robotic manipulation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SoftPAT3D，将文本生成的布料、毛绒玩具、绳索等可形变物体转为可直接仿真的物理有效资产：从制造方式构造静止形状、由材料库赋初值，并把物体放入无穿模的初始位姿，用统一接触模型驱动到静态平衡；失败时用网格搜索与可微仿真的伴随梯度修正放置与材料参数，并用几何检查加 VLM 判定完成。
AI.relevance_reason: 主题上属 3D 资产与物理仿真生成，与视觉推理主线相距较远；但「在物理状态上做伴随梯度优化以达成目标」可能为 latent 状态的贡献分配与目标优化提供线索，「VLM 校验完成」也可供核查验证与停止判据的用法。
